newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Mostly esier European feeds start slow.
newsitem.headline: Mostly esier European feeds start slow.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market started the day quietly with sellers offering South American soymeal pellets between $4 lower for nearby material to $2 up for positions from Oct onwards following last night's Chicago soymeal futures close, market sources said.
Most other products were offered unchanged to slightly easier in sympathy with soymeal. No trades were reported during the early stages of the market.

"Buyers here see nearby Chicago drop further on liquidating the July contract and do not buy Chicago's fears for hot and dry weather in U.S. soybean growing areas," one broker said.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
